exposure: Collaborative midwifery-obstetrician intrapartum model of care
Internal HCP refresher training on teamwork and intrapartum care
cohort: The study included 24,414 women who gave birth at a private Brazilian hospital, specifically focusing on women without previous CS in spontaneous labour with single cephalic pregnancies at term (Robson groups 1 and 3).
finding: An intrapartum care quality improvement initiative for internal healthcare providers was associated with a safe reduction of caesarean section rates in Robson-1 and 3 women, without significant changes in adverse maternal and perinatal outcomes or maternal satisfaction.
mod_finding: The quality improvement initiative led to a 32% relative decrease in Robson-1 CS rates, a 43% relative decrease in Robson-3 CS rates, and an 11% relative decrease in overall CS rates for women managed by internal HCPs.
